meta.name: neopolis_invasion
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist metropolis under sea monster assault

programs.brief: A colossal multi-eyed sea leviathan with massive spiked tentacles rising 38 blocks out of the waves, gaping jaws turned toward the city quays, dark scaled carapace and bioluminescent spines.
A towering modern-classical bronze and polished quartz colossus of Poseidon standing on a monumental stepped marble plinth overlooking the bay, raising a massive trident to strike invading monsters.
A thick muscular sea-monster tentacle erupting from the sea spray, covered with suckers, chitinous barnacles, and barbed fins, curling toward the harbour walls.

tokens.terrain: a grand coastal metropolis fronting a wide deep sea bay and harbour
tokens.event_direction: colossal sea monsters emerge from the open sea attacking the waterfront and harbour
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the coastal boulevard; emergency cordon sealing the harbour promenade
tokens.icons: monumental classical colonnades, stoas and temples integrated into modern city blocks; colossal tentacled sea leviathans crashing onto the piers and avenues
